"""Qualify complete class/frame publication with distinct snapshot/current roles."""
import argparse
import copy
import json
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path('docs/audits/record-value-class-frame-publication-20261006')
CHECKS = Path('docs/audits/class-frame-publication-checks-20261006')
RETENTION = Path('docs/audits/record-value-class-frame-retention-20261006')
RETENTION_CHECKS = Path('docs/audits/class-frame-retention-checks-20261006')
REVISION = '50dd117496d4d226bff3cf2a5226caab45104416'
OWNER = 'SEMANTIC-INTROSPECTION-MCP-FRONTIER.60.4.3.3.5.2.1.5.2.2.3.1.2.1.3.1.2.3.2.3.3.3.3.2.3.2.3.3.2.3.2.2.2.6.3.3'
CHAPTER = Path('docs/book/src/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.md')
TOOLING_CHAPTER = Path('docs/book/src/90-reference-map.md')
REGISTRY = Path('doctrine/live_document_size/surfaces.jsonl')
SUCCESS = 'PASS complete committed class/frame publication source and saved snapshot; current currency requires --current.\n'
CURRENT_SUCCESS = 'PASS current complete class/frame core observer tooling facts, actual question ownership and canonical source routes under unchanged authority.\n'
REPLAY_SUCCESS = 'PASS fresh complete retention semantic and independent actual-result prerequisites; no current publication claimed.\n'


def module(path):
    ns = {'__name__':'class_frame_publication','__file__':str(path)}
    exec(compile(path.read_bytes(),str(path),'exec'),ns)
    return ns


retention = module(RETENTION / 'verify.py')
require,same,identity,load,whole = (retention[k] for k in ('require','same','identity','load','whole'))
metadata,public = retention['metadata'],retention['public']
model = module(BASE / 'model.py'); book = module(BASE / 'book.py')
PATHS,CORE,OBSERVER,TOOLING = (model[k] for k in ('PATHS','CORE','OBSERVER','TOOLING'))


def git(path):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git','show',REVISION + ':' + str(path)])


def save(name,value):
    path = BASE / name
    if path.exists(): require(same(load(path),value),'whole immutable publication product: ' + name)
    else:
        require(not (BASE / 'manifest.json').exists(),'sealed publication cannot add products')
        path.write_text(json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,indent=2) + '\n')


def members():
    return {str(Path(p).relative_to(BASE)):pin for p,pin in whole(BASE).items() if Path(p) != BASE / 'manifest.json'}


def binding():
    roots = sorted({Path(p) for p in load(RETENTION / 'binding.json')['inputs']} | {RETENTION,RETENTION_CHECKS},key=str)
    authority = retention['intake']['admission']; previous = authority['REVISION']
    try:
        authority['REVISION'] = REVISION
        inputs = authority['committed_inputs'](roots)
        task = git(retention['intake']['TASK'])
        owners = authority['owner_rows'](roots,task.decode())
    finally: authority['REVISION'] = previous
    return dict(revision=REVISION,owner=OWNER,inputs=inputs,owners=owners,task=identity(task),
        scope='Complete committed retention/admission/source/semantic/actual-result/native domains and every transitive member; original captures remain immutable retained evidence.')


def check_binding(candidate,expected):
    require(candidate['revision'] == REVISION and candidate['owner'] == OWNER and candidate['scope'] == expected['scope'],'complete publication custody epoch owner and native scope')
    require(all(type(p['bytes']) is int and p['bytes'] >= 0 for rows in candidate['inputs'].values() for p in rows.values()),'publication custody discrete member byte-count kinds')
    require(same(candidate['inputs'],expected['inputs']),'whole committed publication source semantic and actual-result member population')
    require(same(candidate['owners'],expected['owners']) and same(candidate['task'],expected['task']),'whole completed publication owner and task authority')
    require(same(candidate,expected),'closed complete publication custody')


def semantic_products():
    retention['check_binding'](load(RETENTION / 'binding.json'),retention['binding']())
    retention['construct'](); proposal,review = load(RETENTION / 'proposal.json'),load(RETENTION / 'retention-map.json')
    sources = retention['original_sources']()
    derived = dict(
        semantic=retention['semantics'](proposal,review,sources),
        collection=retention['collection'](proposal,sources),
        authority=retention['authority'](),
        controls=retention['controls'](proposal,review,sources,load(RETENTION / 'binding.json')),
        recoveries=module(RETENTION / 'recoveries.py')['check'](retention),
        admission=retention['fresh_admission'](False),
        native=module(RETENTION / 'book.py')['proof']((RETENTION / 'book-input.html').read_text()))
    names = dict(semantic='semantic-proof.json',collection='collection-proof.json',authority='source-authority.json',controls='controls.json',
        recoveries='recovery-proof.json',admission='admission-proof.json',native='book-proof.json')
    for key,name in names.items(): require(same(derived[key],load(RETENTION / name)),'whole regenerated complete publication prerequisite: ' + key)
    require(same(load(RETENTION / 'manifest.json'),retention['members']()),'whole immutable publication retention seal')
    return dict(semantic=derived['semantic'],controls=derived['controls'],class_frame_controls=derived['authority']['semantic_products']['controls'],
        qualified_full_products={key:dict(path=str(RETENTION / name),identity=identity((RETENTION / name).read_bytes())) for key,name in names.items()},
        scope='Every complete prerequisite value is reconstructed and compared to its committed corpus. Full retained products remain canonical without duplicating their representations; original native/private/formatter/identity/coordinate/address gaps conserve.')


def sources():
    paths = subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-r','--name-only',REVISION,'docs/knowledge','docs/decisions'],text=True).splitlines()
    return metadata['git_blobs'](REVISION,sorted(p for p in paths if p.endswith('.md')))


def source_model():
    original = sources(); cards = model['cards']()
    prior = load(RETENTION / 'proposal.json')
    for path,text in cards.items():
        require(original[path].decode() == prior[path]['before'],'whole original publication card source epoch: ' + path)
        require(text.rsplit('---\n',1)[1] == prior[path]['after'].rsplit('---\n',1)[1],'complete reviewed retained and added publication body: ' + path)
        require(metadata['metadata'](text.encode()) == metadata['metadata'](original[path]),'exact original publication identity and ordered questions: ' + path)
    old_core = model['replay_value'](original[CORE].decode()).split(' && ')
    require(model['replay_value'](cards[CORE]).split(' && ') == [*old_core,model['COMMAND']],'whole unchanged original helper finite join probe replay and added current chain')
    old_locality = model['replay_value'](original[TOOLING].decode()).split(' && ')[0]
    require(model['replay_value'](cards[TOOLING]).split(' && ') == [old_locality,model['COMMAND']]
        and model['replay_value'](cards[OBSERVER]) == model['COMMAND'],'complete original locality and atomic observer tooling current obligations')
    physical = {p:raw for p,raw in original.items() if Path(p).parent == Path('docs/knowledge')}
    after = {**physical,**{p:text.encode() for p,text in cards.items()}}
    surface = public['authority'](git(REGISTRY)); public['within'](public['metrics'](after),surface)
    before_allocation,after_allocation = metadata['allocation'](original),metadata['allocation']({**original,**{p:t.encode() for p,t in cards.items()}})
    require(same(before_allocation,after_allocation),'whole unchanged publication global question identity path and occurrence allocation')
    budget = next(json.loads(s) for s in git(REGISTRY).decode().splitlines() if json.loads(s).get('surface_id') == 'book_source_manifest')
    return dict(revision=REVISION,cards=cards,before_members={p:identity(r) for p,r in physical.items()},after_members={p:identity(r) for p,r in after.items()},
        before=public['metrics'](physical),after=public['metrics'](after),allocation=before_allocation,surface=surface,source_budget=budget,
        body_scope='Exact complete committed retention bodies; only declared core date/join citation and all current routes change. Original helper/probe/locality obligations retain.',
        legs=dict(rederive='whole fixed-Git physical/logical source and original questions, exact admitted body/current metadata transform and every capacity dimension',
            falsify='genuine original body/qualifier/question/route/kind/member/native-scope/budget and borrowed-role losses refuse',
            durability='tracked model, complete source/semantic/actual-result/native products, immutable seal and independent actual-result consumption'))


def target_rows(text):
    allocation = metadata['allocation']({p:t.encode() for p,t in model['cards']().items()})
    wanted = {line.split('\t')[0] for line in allocation['rows'].splitlines()}; ids = {Path(p).stem for p in PATHS}
    rows = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        fields = line.split('\t'); require(len(fields) == 3,'complete actual publication query row grammar')
        if fields[0] in wanted or ids.intersection(fields[1].split(',')): rows.append(line)
    return sorted(rows)


def current_input():
    return dict(cards={p:Path(p).read_text() for p in PATHS},chapter=CHAPTER.read_text(),tooling_chapter=TOOLING_CHAPTER.read_text(),
        queries=public['queries'](),census=public['metrics'](public['cards']()),surface=public['authority'](REGISTRY.read_bytes()),
        physical_members={p:identity(raw) for p,raw in public['cards']().items()},
        source_budget=next(json.loads(s) for s in REGISTRY.read_text().splitlines() if json.loads(s).get('surface_id') == 'book_source_manifest'))


def check_current(record):
    require(record['cards'] == model['cards'](),'complete current class/frame retained facts qualifiers questions identity and all routes')
    require(record['chapter'].count(book['GUIDE']) == 1 and record['chapter'].count(book['EPOCH']) == 1
        and all(record['chapter'].count('```bash\n' + command + '\n```') == 1 for command in (book['COMMAND'],book['DEFAULT'],book['BUILD'])),
        'unique exact current default native and retained publication guides')
    public['within'](record['census'],record['surface'])
    declared = source_model()
    require(all(type(pin['bytes']) is int and pin['bytes'] >= 0 for pin in record['physical_members'].values()),'current physical member discrete byte-count kinds')
    require(same(record['physical_members'],declared['after_members']),'whole current physical member and non-target source conservation')
    require(same(record['census'],declared['after']),'whole exact current physical population census')
    require(set(record['queries']) == {'direct','cached'},'complete actual current direct cached query roles')
    expected = sorted(metadata['allocation']({p:t.encode() for p,t in model['cards']().items()})['rows'].splitlines())
    for role,actual in record['queries'].items():
        require(type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status'] == 0,'actual current query integer success')
        command = ['knowledge-map/scripts/query_knowledge_map.sh','--all'] + (['--no-cache'] if role == 'direct' else [])
        require(actual['command'] == command and actual['stderr'] == '','whole distinct actual current query command and streams')
        require(target_rows(actual['stdout']) == expected,'whole current class/frame question ownership')
        require(actual['stdout'] == declared['allocation']['rows'],'whole global current question identity path and occurrence allocation')
    budget = declared['source_budget']
    require(same(record['source_budget'],budget),'whole unchanged current canonical source budget')
    plane = module(Path('scripts/book_source_references.py'))
    original = load(Path('docs/audits/book-source-plane-20261005/book-authority.json'))['block'].split('\nThe asset plane is available;',1)[0]
    require(record['tooling_chapter'].count(original) == 1,'unique complete canonical source and native build roles')
    for row in plane['expected_rows']():
        chapter = record['chapter'] if row['chapter'] == CHAPTER.stem else record['tooling_chapter']
        require(chapter.count('](' + row['asset'] + ')') == 1,'unique complete publication canonical source destination')


def replay_specs():
    return [dict(name='semantic',path=str(RETENTION / 'verify.py'),stdout=retention['SUCCESS']),
        dict(name='independent',path=str(RETENTION_CHECKS / 'verify_seal.py'),stdout=load(RETENTION_CHECKS / 'independent-result.json')['stdout'])]


def replays(fresh):
    result = {}
    for spec in replay_specs():
        path = BASE / ('replay-' + spec['name'] + '.json'); command = ['python3','-B',spec['path']]
        # The whole actual prerequisite caller preceded the explicitly
        # qualified stronger current predicate. It never executed current mode.
        instruments = {str(BASE / 'verify.py'):identity((CHECKS / 'first-verify.py.txt').read_bytes()),
                       spec['path']:identity(Path(spec['path']).read_bytes())}
        if fresh:
            require(not path.exists(),'actual publication prerequisite cannot overwrite an execution')
            execution = subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True)
            save(path.name,dict(command=command,status=execution.returncode,stdout=execution.stdout.decode(),stderr=execution.stderr.decode(),
                instruments=instruments,binding=identity((BASE / 'binding.json').read_bytes()),
                role='Fresh full retained semantic/actual-result execution; original raw and transitive native captures retained, never recaptured.'))
        actual = load(path)
        require(type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status'] == 0 and actual['command'] == command and actual['stdout'] == spec['stdout'] and actual['stderr'] == '',
                'whole complete actual publication prerequisite command status and streams')
        require(same(actual['instruments'],instruments) and same(actual['binding'],identity((BASE / 'binding.json').read_bytes()))
            and actual['role'] == 'Fresh full retained semantic/actual-result execution; original raw and transitive native captures retained, never recaptured.',
            'whole publication invocation source and fresh retained native roles')
        require(set(actual) == {'command','status','stdout','stderr','instruments','binding','role'},'closed actual complete publication prerequisite')
        result[spec['name']] = dict(actual=identity(path.read_bytes()),role=actual['role'])
    return result


def controls(record,bound):
    result = []
    def refuse(name,candidate,predicate,cause):
        try: predicate(candidate)
        except ValueError as error:
            require(str(error) == cause,'intended complete publication refusal: ' + name + ': ' + str(error))
            result.append(dict(control=name,status=1,cause=cause))
        else: raise ValueError('false-green publication control: ' + name)
    for name,mutate,cause in (
        ('core-native-promotion',lambda r:r['cards'].update({CORE:r['cards'][CORE].replace('classes were unmeasured','classes were measured',1)}),'complete current class/frame retained facts qualifiers questions identity and all routes'),
        ('observer-body-loss',lambda r:r['cards'].update({OBSERVER:r['cards'][OBSERVER].replace('opaque retained evidence','formatter evidence',1)}),'complete current class/frame retained facts qualifiers questions identity and all routes'),
        ('lost-tooling-locality-obligation',lambda r:r['cards'].update({TOOLING:r['cards'][TOOLING].replace('Original destination-locality replay remains required.','Original destination-locality replay is optional.',1)}),'complete current class/frame retained facts qualifiers questions identity and all routes'),
        ('lost-question',lambda r:r['cards'].update({OBSERVER:r['cards'][OBSERVER].replace('  - "what inventories original observer and callback source roles?"\n','',1)}),'complete current class/frame retained facts qualifiers questions identity and all routes'),
        ('borrowed-old-current-route',lambda r:r['cards'].update({OBSERVER:git(OBSERVER).decode()}),'complete current class/frame retained facts qualifiers questions identity and all routes'),
        ('borrowed-question-owner',lambda r:r['queries']['direct'].update(stdout=r['queries']['direct']['stdout'].replace('\tmdbook-build-destination-locality\t','\tborrowed-tooling\t')),'whole current class/frame question ownership'),
        ('snapshot-current-guide',lambda r:r.update(chapter=r['chapter'].replace(book['COMMAND'],book['DEFAULT'])),'unique exact current default native and retained publication guides'),
        ('lost-source-budget',lambda r:r['source_budget']['targets'].clear(),'whole unchanged current canonical source budget'),
        ('Boolean-current-capacity',lambda r:r['census'].update(files=True),'physical capacity kind/allowance: files'),
        ('lost-capacity-dimension',lambda r:r['census'].pop('bytes_total'),'complete physical capacity dimensions'),
        ('widened-current-authority',lambda r:r['surface']['transition']['max_growth'].update(files=999),'whole unchanged physical card authority')):
        changed = copy.deepcopy(record); mutate(changed); require(not same(changed,record),'genuine full current publication intervention: ' + name)
        refuse(name,changed,check_current,cause)
    for status in (True,0.0,1):
        changed = copy.deepcopy(record); changed['queries']['direct']['status'] = status
        refuse('query-status-' + repr(status),changed,check_current,'actual current query integer success')
    ids = {Path(p).stem for p in PATHS}
    line = next(line for line in record['queries']['direct']['stdout'].splitlines() if not ids.intersection(line.split('\t')[1].split(',')))
    changed = copy.deepcopy(record); changed['queries']['direct']['stdout'] = changed['queries']['direct']['stdout'].replace(line + '\n','',1)
    refuse('lost-non-target-global-question',changed,check_current,'whole global current question identity path and occurrence allocation')
    changed = copy.deepcopy(record); changed['physical_members'].pop(next(iter(changed['physical_members'])))
    refuse('lost-non-target-physical-member',changed,check_current,'whole current physical member and non-target source conservation')
    changed = copy.deepcopy(record); next(iter(changed['physical_members'].values()))['bytes'] = True
    refuse('Boolean-physical-member-count',changed,check_current,'current physical member discrete byte-count kinds')
    changed = copy.deepcopy(record); changed['census']['files'] -= 1
    refuse('reduced-current-population',changed,check_current,'whole exact current physical population census')
    for name,mutate,cause in (
        ('lost-completed-owner',lambda r:r['owners'].pop(next(iter(r['owners']))),'whole completed publication owner and task authority'),
        ('lost-source-result-member',lambda r:next(iter(r['inputs'].values())).pop(next(iter(next(iter(r['inputs'].values()))))),'whole committed publication source semantic and actual-result member population'),
        ('Boolean-source-count',lambda r:next(iter(next(iter(r['inputs'].values())).values())).update(bytes=True),'publication custody discrete member byte-count kinds'),
        ('original-native-recapture-promotion',lambda r:r.update(scope='Original native classes and private identities recaptured.'),'complete publication custody epoch owner and native scope')):
        changed = copy.deepcopy(bound); mutate(changed); require(not same(changed,bound),'genuine publication custody intervention: ' + name)
        refuse(name,changed,lambda r:check_binding(r,bound),cause)
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--prepare',action='store_true'); parser.add_argument('--replay',action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--current',action='store_true'); parser.add_argument('--build'); parser.add_argument('--seal',action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    require(not ((args.prepare or args.replay) and (args.current or args.build or args.seal)) and not(args.prepare and args.replay),'publication preparation replay and current roles are distinct')
    require(args.current or args.build is None,'native publication build requires explicit current role')
    if (BASE / 'manifest.json').exists():
        require(not args.prepare and not args.replay,'sealed publication cannot recapture')
        require(same(load(BASE / 'manifest.json'),members()),'whole immutable complete publication manifest')
    bound = binding(); check_binding(bound,bound); save('binding.json',bound)
    save('semantic-proof.json',semantic_products()); save('source-model.json',source_model())
    if args.prepare:
        print('PASS complete publication source/semantic/capacity preparation; actual replay and atomic current publication remain required.'); return
    save('replay-proof.json',replays(args.replay))
    if args.replay: print(REPLAY_SUCCESS,end=''); return
    publication = load(BASE / 'publication.json'); check_current(publication['snapshot'])
    save('controls.json',controls(publication['snapshot'],bound))
    save('native-proof.json',book['proof']((BASE / 'native-input.html').read_text()))
    if args.current:
        check_current(current_input())
        plane = module(Path('scripts/book_source_references.py')); rows = plane['expected_rows']()
        plane['check'](rows); plane['check_index'](rows)
        if args.build:
            output = Path(args.build)
            require(not output.is_absolute() and '..' not in output.parts and output.resolve().is_relative_to(Path.cwd())
                and output.stat().st_dev == Path.cwd().stat().st_dev,'repository-relative same-volume publication native output')
            plane['check'](rows,args.build); book['check']((output / (CHAPTER.stem + '.html')).read_text())
    if args.seal: save('manifest.json',members())
    print(CURRENT_SUCCESS if args.current else SUCCESS,end='')


if __name__ == '__main__': main()

"""Mutable external gate receipts with durable streams and complete programme epochs."""
import fcntl
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from common import *


def update(name, row, replace=False):
    lock_path = local(Path('.artifacts/raw-semantic-admission-20261011/checks.lock'), exists=False)
    lock_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        records = load('checks.json') if (BASE / 'checks.json').exists() else {}
        need((name in records) == replace, 'retain first complete gate receipt')
        records[name] = row
        (BASE / 'checks.json').write_bytes(canonical(records))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv) >= 3, 'named explicit gate command')
    name, command = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:]
    need(name and all(c.isalnum() or c == '-' for c in name), 'closed gate receipt label')
    folder = local(Path('.artifacts/raw-semantic-admission-20261011/checks') / name, exists=False)
    need(not folder.exists(), 'fresh complete gate stream directory')
    folder.mkdir(parents=True)
    epoch = programs()
    inputs = {path: row['identity'] for path, row in epoch.items()}
    for arg in command:
        if '\n' not in arg and len(arg) < 240 and Path(arg).is_file():
            inputs[arg] = pin(local(arg).read_bytes())
    for path in ('scripts/check_record_value_publication.py', 'scripts/record_value_observer_fact.py',
                 'scripts/record_value_observer_namespace_fact.py', 'docs/book/src/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.md',
                 'docs/knowledge/record-value-original-observer-helper-paths.md'):
        inputs[path] = pin(local(path).read_bytes())
    stdout, stderr = folder / 'stdout.txt', folder / 'stderr.txt'
    started = dict(command=command, programmes=epoch, inputs=inputs, stdout_path=str(stdout), stderr_path=str(stderr),
                   outcome='started; missing terminal result is non-success')
    update(name, started)
    with stdout.open('xb', buffering=0) as out, stderr.open('xb', buffering=0) as err:
        result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=out, stderr=err)
    after = {path: pin(local(path).read_bytes()) for path in inputs}
    record = dict(**started, status=result.returncode, stdout=stdout.read_bytes().decode(), stderr=stderr.read_bytes().decode(),
                  inputs_after=after, epoch_conserved=inputs == after)
    update(name, record, replace=True)
    print(name, result.returncode, record['stdout'][-1800:], record['stderr'][-1800:], flush=True)
    need(after == inputs, 'whole gate programme/source epoch conserved')
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0, 'actual successful external gate: ' + name)

"""Publish only completed admission; raw semantic association stays pending."""
import base64
import copy
import gzip
import re
from pathlib import Path
from common import *
import run
import verify

SURFACES = 'doctrine/live_document_size/surfaces.jsonl'
BOOK = 'docs/book/src/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.md'


def authority(before, task_sources, book_sources, book_after):
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in before.splitlines()]
    measured = metrics(task_sources)['metrics']
    for row in rows:
        if row.get('surface_id') == 'task_evidence':
            need(row['state'] == 'warning_debt' and measured['lines_each'] < 7200, 'owned warning-debt work before rollover')
            for key, value in measured.items():
                need(value <= row['enforcement_ceilings'][key], 'unchanged task ceilings')
                row['transition']['max_growth'][key] = max(0, value + row['transition']['ratchet_step'][key] - row['baseline'][key])
        elif row.get('surface_id') == 'shipped_behavior':
            baseline = metrics(book_sources)['metrics']
            current = dict(book_sources)
            current[BOOK] = book_after
            after = metrics(current)['metrics']
            keys = ('files', 'bytes_total', 'lines_total')
            row['reference_contract']['aggregate_change'] = dict(authority_id='RAW-SEMANTIC-ADMISSION-20261011',
                owner=OWNER, baseline={key: baseline[key] for key in keys},
                delta={key: after[key]-baseline[key] for key in keys},
                rationale='Document complete fresh raw-semantic source/prerequisite admission and explicit fixed-instrument replay condition; full raw association/publication and original native/private scopes stay open.')
    return b''.join(canonical(row) for row in rows)


def main():
    actuals = verify.actual_readers()
    native_paths = sorted(BASE.glob('actual-native-census-*.json'))
    need(len(native_paths) == 1, 'complete first independent native census')
    actual = json.loads(native_paths[0].read_bytes())
    need(type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status'] == 0 and actual['stderr'] == '', 'actual full native source census')
    save('native-census.json', dict(receipt=str(native_paths[0]), identity=pin(native_paths[0].read_bytes())))
    need(load('intake-before.json') == load('intake-after.json'), 'whole source condition before publication')
    topology = load('topology-controls.json')
    diagnostic = topology['cases']['changed-tail']['native']['stderr']
    locus = re.search(r' at [^\s]+ line [0-9]+', diagnostic)
    need(locus is not None, 'actual native control diagnostic locus')
    current = local(TASK).read_bytes()
    graph = verify.task_nodes(current)
    block = graph[OWNER]
    need(verify.field(block, 'Status') == 'active', 'own live admission leaf before finish')

"""Stream every complete fixed Git member and independently check directory closure."""
import os
import stat
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import *


def fixed_json(path):
    return json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':' + str(path)))


def roots():
    selected = set(fixed_json(PRIOR / 'intake-qualified.json')['roots'])
    selected.update(str(path) for path in (PRIOR,
        Path('docs/audits/raw-stack-prerequisite-gate-repair-20261011'),
        Path('docs/audits/task-terminal-rollover-20261011')))
    selected.add('docs/audits/coordinate-public-route-checks-20261008/drafts.tar.gz')
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():
    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:
        for name, entry in sorted(population.items()):
            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()
            need(bool(before.st_mode & 0o111) == (entry['mode'] == '100755'), 'complete source executable mode')
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[0].decode() == entry['oid'] and header[1] == b'blob'
                 and int(header[2]) == before.st_size, 'whole fixed/current source object header')
            remaining = before.st_size
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                 (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'source member epoch conserved')
            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',
             'whole fixed Git source stream')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    need(graph(selected, population) == directories, 'whole source topology epoch conserved')
    task = git('show', REVISION + ':' + TASK)
    return dict(revision=REVISION, owner=OWNER, scope=SCOPE, roots=selected, directories=directories,
        members=members, original_task=dict(identity=pin(task), body=task.decode()),
        retention_contract='fsmgen_required_history',
        recovery='Retrieve complete full-revision Git objects under the repository required-history retention contract; never regenerate native captures.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--after', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = derive()
    save('intake-after.json' if args.after else 'intake-before.json', result)
    if args.after:
        need(result == load('intake-before.json'), 'whole input source/native/product epoch conserved across every reader')

"""Durably stream every child outcome, including interruption-time output."""
import argparse
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import *


def execute(label, command):
    need(label and all(c.isalnum() or c == '-' for c in label), 'closed source/result label')
    attempts = list(BASE.glob('started-' + label + '-*.json'))
    number = max((int(path.stem.rsplit('-', 1)[1]) for path in attempts), default=0) + 1
    prefix = label + '-' + str(number)
    stdout = local(BASE / (prefix + '.stdout.txt'), exists=False)
    stderr = local(BASE / (prefix + '.stderr.txt'), exists=False)
    need(not stdout.exists() and not stderr.exists(), 'retain first full child streams')
    epoch = programs()
    instruments = {arg: dict(body=(raw := local(arg).read_bytes()).decode(), identity=pin(raw))
                   for arg in command if Path(arg).is_file()}
    started = dict(command=command, programs=epoch, direct_instruments=instruments,
        stdout_path=str(stdout), stderr_path=str(stderr), owner=OWNER, source_revision=REVISION,
        scope='Pre-execution only. A missing actual result is non-success; stream files retain bytes even if the guard terminates this process tree.')
    save('started-' + prefix + '.json', started)
    with stdout.open('xb', buffering=0) as out, stderr.open('xb', buffering=0) as err:
        result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=out, stderr=err)
    out, err = stdout.read_bytes(), stderr.read_bytes()
    after = {path: pin(local(path).read_bytes()) for path in epoch | instruments}
    before = {path: row['identity'] for path, row in (epoch | instruments).items()}
    record = dict(**started, status=result.returncode, stdout=out.decode(), stderr=err.decode(),
                  stdout_identity=pin(out), stderr_identity=pin(err), inputs_after=after, epoch_conserved=before == after)
    name = 'actual-' + prefix + '.json'
    save(name, record)
    print(name, result.returncode, record['stdout'][-400:], record['stderr'][-1000:], flush=True)
    # Persist full actual result before evaluating status, streams or currency.
    need(before == after, 'complete declared reader programme epoch conserved')
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0, 'actual successful child status: ' + name)
    return name, record


def qualify(record, spec):
    need(type(record.get('status')) is int and record['status'] == 0, 'actual integer reader success')
    need(record['command'] == spec['command'], 'exact complete reader command')
    need(type(record['stdout']) is str and record['stderr'] == '', 'whole clean reader streams')
    need(record['stdout'] == spec['stdout'] if spec['match'] == 'whole' else record['stdout'].endswith(spec['stdout']),
         'complete declared source or dated reader stdout role')
    need(record['epoch_conserved'] is True, 'whole reader programme conservation')
    need(type(record['programs']) is dict and set(record['programs']) == set(programs())
         and type(record['direct_instruments']) is dict and bool(record['direct_instruments']),
         'complete own reader runner and direct instrument population')
    need(record['stdout_identity'] == pin(record['stdout'].encode())
         and record['stderr_identity'] == pin(record['stderr'].encode()), 'complete durably retained actual streams')
    for path, programme in (record['programs'] | record['direct_instruments']).items():
        need(pin(programme['body'].encode()) == programme['identity'] == record['inputs_after'][path],
             'whole actual reader programme and final epoch')
    need(all(row['identity'] == programs()[path]['identity'] for path, row in record['programs'].items()),
         'exact current source of every retained own runner programme')


def specifications():
    prior = json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':' + str(PRIOR / 'readers.json')))
    result = {name: row['specification'] for name, row in prior['readers'].items()}
    checks = json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':docs/audits/task-terminal-rollover-20261011/checks.json'))
    result['complete-prerequisite-default'] = dict(command=['python3', '-B', str(PRIOR / 'verify.py')],
        stdout=checks['prior-raw-dated']['stdout'], match='whole', authority=str(PRIOR / 'verify.py'),
        context='complete dated prerequisite acceptance; no later native/current publication currency')
    result['task-containment-dated'] = dict(command=['python3', '-B', 'docs/audits/task-terminal-rollover-20261011/verify.py'],
        stdout=checks['default-current']['stdout'], match='whole',
        authority='docs/audits/task-terminal-rollover-20261011/verify.py', context='complete retained dated task/source/registry epoch')
    result['aggregate-prerequisite-correction'] = dict(command=['python3', '-B', 'docs/audits/raw-stack-prerequisite-gate-repair-20261011/verify.py'],
        stdout='PASS retained aggregate gate refusal, independent complete task-source census and exact measured allowance correction; every ceiling and Knowledge Map allowance remains unchanged.\n',
        match='whole', authority='docs/audits/raw-stack-prerequisite-gate-repair-20261011/verify.py',
        context='complete dated task-source/registry correction; no later allowance currency')
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--readers', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--fresh-readers', action='store_true',
                        help='Explicitly rerun every reader; retain all earlier attempts unchanged.')
    parser.add_argument('arguments', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.readers:
        need(not args.fresh_readers, 'fresh execution requires whole-reader selection')
        need(len(args.arguments) >= 2, 'explicit named command')
        execute(args.arguments[0], args.arguments[1:])
        return
    need(not args.arguments, 'closed whole-reader selection')
    need(load('intake-before.json')['revision'] == REVISION, 'complete whole source admission before readers')
    result = {}
    specs = specifications()
    # Execute the longest complete coordinate reader last; every role still runs.
    names = sorted(specs, key=lambda name: (name == 'address-coordinate', name))
    for name in names:
        spec = specs[name]
        existing = sorted(BASE.glob('actual-reader-' + name + '-*.json'),
                          key=lambda path: int(path.stem.rsplit('-', 1)[1]))
        if existing and not args.fresh_readers:
            path = existing[-1]
            record = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
            qualify(record, spec)
        else:
            filename, record = execute('reader-' + name, spec['command'])
            path = BASE / filename
            qualify(record, spec)
        result[name] = dict(specification=spec, receipt=str(path), identity=pin(path.read_bytes()))
    save('readers.json', dict(revision=REVISION, owner=OWNER, scope=SCOPE, readers=result))
    print('PASS every complete declared raw-semantic admission reader freshly executed in its explicit source or dated role; full actual programmes and both streams retain.')

def task_nodes(raw):
    marker = b'## Task Tree\n'
    need(raw.count(marker) == 1, 'unique authoritative task graph')
    section = raw.split(marker, 1)[1].split(b'\n## ', 1)[0]
    matches = list(re.finditer(rb'^- ID: `([^`]+)`\n.*?(?=^- ID: `|\Z)', section, re.M | re.S))
    result = {match[1].decode(): match[0] for match in matches}
    need(len(result) == len(matches), 'unique authoritative task identities')
    return result


def field(raw, key):
    values = re.findall(rb'^  ' + key.encode() + rb': `([^`\n]*)`$', raw, re.M)
    need(len(values) == 1, 'whole task field ' + key)
    return values[0].decode()


def contracts(source, declared, final):
    before, active, after = map(task_nodes, (source, declared, final))
    parent = OWNER.rsplit('.', 1)[0]
    new_ids = {parent + '.' + str(index) for index in range(1, 4)}
    need(set(active) == set(before) | new_ids and set(after) == set(active), 'only declared raw semantic children added')
    for name, block in before.items():
        if name == parent:
            need(all(field(active[name], key) == field(block, key) == field(after[name], key)
                     for key in ('Goal', 'Acceptance')), 'original full raw semantic parent contract conserves')
        else:
            need(active[name] == block == after[name], 'every unrelated complete task node remains exact')
    need(all(active[name] == after[name] for name in new_ids if name != OWNER), 'both semantic successors unchanged')
    need(field(after[OWNER], 'Status') == 'done' and field(after[OWNER], 'Commit') != 'pending', 'closed admission owner')
    need(final == declared.replace(active[OWNER], after[OWNER], 1), 'whole final task changes only by admission closure')
    return dict(original_task=pin(source), declared_task=pin(declared), qualified_task=pin(final),
                parent_goal=field(before[parent], 'Goal'), parent_acceptance=field(before[parent], 'Acceptance'),
                unchanged_nodes={name: pin(raw) for name, raw in before.items() if name != parent})
